Consumer Marketing Lead — Alpen Finance

Alpen Finance is an early-stage consumer financial app for people who want more useful ways to hold and use Bitcoin and stablecoins (Alpen Finance is currently an internal project name). Our vision is a global, Bitcoin-native, neobank-like experience that gives people access to services such as borrowing, earning interest, and spending while preserving greater control over their money.

Alpen Finance is being built by Alpen Labs, which develops infrastructure for financial markets on Bitcoin. Our zero-knowledge technology and programmable Layer 2 infrastructure make new financial applications possible on Bitcoin.

Our team includes members from zkSync, Uniswap, Mina and P2P, alongside contributors to major open-source blockchain projects. We bring together experience across financial technology, onchain finance, payments, product, and marketing.

The role

We’re hiring a Consumer Marketing Lead to build the consumer marketing function for Alpen Finance and acquire its first meaningful base of customers.

The product is prelaunch. We have an initial brand, positioning, and go-to-market direction, but no proven acquisition playbook or established channel mix. You’ll build on that foundation, test the assumptions behind it, and turn it into a focused strategy and practical marketing plan.

The immediate focus is acquisition and execution: identifying promising early customers, translating the product’s value into effective messaging, testing channels, and building qualified demand ahead of launch. You’ll use customer conversations, campaign results, and early product behavior to refine the approach and inform product and launch decisions.

This is a hands-on role for a marketer with meaningful consumer mobile app experience, broad marketing fundamentals, and entrepreneurial judgment. You’ll work closely with leadership, product, and engineering while personally driving strategy and execution through launch, adoption, and growth.

What you’ll do

  • Develop and execute the marketing strategy. Build on the existing brand and go-to-market foundation to establish clear priorities, campaigns, budgets, and an operating cadence.

  • Identify valuable early customers. Test hypotheses about audiences, use cases, and customer needs. Understand what would motivate people to try Alpen Finance and keep using it.

  • Refine positioning and messaging. Turn the product’s value into clear, compelling communication, using customer research and experiments to improve it.

  • Build the acquisition mix. Test content, community, referrals, partnerships, creators, events, and selective paid media, including approaches suited to markets where conventional advertising is constrained.

  • Personally run campaigns and experiments. Create assets, launch programs, evaluate results, and turn promising approaches into repeatable acquisition programs.

  • Own marketing for the unveiling and launch. Coordinate campaigns, content, channel activity, early access, and customer communications. Build demand while setting accurate expectations and sustain momentum after launch.

  • Improve the customer journey. Work with product and engineering to understand friction from awareness and onboarding through activation, repeat use, and referral. Connect the marketing promise with the experience customers have in the app.

  • Use evidence to guide growth. Establish measurement and feedback loops, distinguish meaningful demand from low-intent interest, and evaluate customer quality, retention, and economics. Bring those findings into decisions about marketing investment, launch markets, and product priorities.

What we’re looking for

  • Relevant experience: 3+ years in marketing or growth, with meaningful ownership of go-to-market strategy, customer acquisition, and adoption.

  • Consumer mobile app experience: You have directly marketed or grown a consumer app and understand the journey from discovery and installation to activation and repeated use.

  • Early-stage launch experience: You have helped take a consumer product from prelaunch or an early stage through launch and meaningful adoption, building an approach before an established playbook existed.

  • Customer and product judgment: You can point to examples where customer research or behavior changed your audience, positioning, campaigns, or product priorities.

  • Broad marketing ownership: You can connect customer understanding, positioning, messaging, acquisition, and lifecycle marketing, and decide what matters most at each stage.

  • Hands-on execution: You can turn strategy into campaigns, content, experiments, and day-to-day operating work.

  • Commercial judgment: You use activation, retention, referral, acquisition costs, and customer economics to decide where to invest.

  • Cross-functional ownership: You work effectively with product, engineering, and leadership, and move work forward with incomplete information.

Experience with consumer financial apps—particularly wallets, payments, neobanking, lending, cards, investing, or brokerage—is strongly preferred. We’re especially interested in experience helping people adopt new financial behaviors through an app.

We care more about demonstrated work, ownership, and judgment than a particular title or career path.

Additional experience we value

  • Consumer Bitcoin or crypto products.

  • Familiarity with U.S. and U.S.-adjacent consumer markets, particularly how Bitcoin and fintech users think about trust, money, and adopting financial apps.

  • Community, creator, referral, partnership, content-led, or product-led acquisition.

  • Marketing products that require clear explanations of risk and meaningful customer trust.

Why join

  • Build an early marketing function: Turn an initial product and brand direction into an effective consumer launch and acquisition strategy.

  • Meaningful ownership: Shape how we reach our first customers, communicate the product’s value, and grow adoption.

  • An open challenge: Find effective ways to market a financial app that does not fit neatly into conventional consumer-finance categories.

  • Close collaboration: Work directly with leadership, product, and engineering to connect customer needs with what we build.

  • Visible impact: Help turn new Bitcoin infrastructure into useful financial experiences for consumers.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The AI Infrastructure team builds and operates the production systems that power intelligent agents at scale. This team sits at the foundation of the agent platform, ensuring that model inference, orchestration, and execution layers are reliable, observable, and performant under real-world load.

Working closely with the Agent Systems team and broader infrastructure partners, this group owns the core primitives that enable agents to safely operate across internal systems. The environment is high-scale and high-stakes — systems serve millions of users and must meet strict reliability, latency, and correctness standards.

This is a deeply production-oriented team. Engineers here combine strong systems thinking with applied ML infrastructure experience, building in Rust and operating services where performance and failure modes matter.

 

The opportunity

  • Design and build the infrastructure layer powering AI agent systems in production

  • Develop high-performance Rust services that handle model inference, orchestration, and execution

  • Architect scalable systems capable of supporting millions of users and high request throughput

  • Build reliable ML infrastructure and MLOps patterns for model deployment, evaluation, and monitoring

  • Define guardrails, observability, and failure handling for agent-driven workflows

  • Optimize latency, throughput, and cost across inference and orchestration layers

  • Partner closely with the Agent Systems team to translate experimental prototypes into hardened production systems

  • Contribute to foundational infrastructure decisions in a high-scale, high-impact environment

 

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating high-scale production systems

  • Strong proficiency in Rust and systems-level programming

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, reliability engineering, and performance optimization

  • Experience operating services serving millions of users or high-throughput workloads

  • Familiarity with ML infrastructure, model serving, or MLOps in production environments

  • Experience designing observability, monitoring, and failure recovery systems

  • Strong collaboration skills working across infrastructure and applied engineering teams

  • High ownership mindset in high-stakes production environment

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience building infrastructure for agent-based or LLM-powered systems

  • Background in high-performance networking, async systems, or low-latency architectures

  • Experience with container orchestration and cloud-native infrastructure

  • Familiarity with evaluation frameworks and model performance monitoring at scale

  • Experience working in fast-moving 0→1 or platform-building teams

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

About Groma

Groma is blending real estate and technology to unlock a new real estate asset class while making it easier for everyone – from institutional investors to the residents in our buildings – to participate in ownership. Our investor technology platform makes owning these assets accessible to a broad array of investors, with bespoke vehicles available to institutional and family office investors and our flagship vehicle, the blockchain-powered GromaREIT, available to everyone, with a special focus on enabling ownership for the residents in our buildings. Visit www.groma.com to learn more about us.

This focused on helping our Finance team find practical ways to use AI to enable the department to work more efficiently and accurately. Over six months, you’ll learn how our finance and accounting processes work, identify opportunities to improve them, and help design and implement solutions using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Python, SQL, and our financial platforms. We're looking for someone who knows more about these tools than we do and wants to teach us. If you'd rather be the resident expert than the person fetching spreadsheets, this is the co-op.

  • Automate recurring finance tasks with AI workflows (Claude, ChatGPT, and their APIs)
  • Map how finance work gets done and prioritize what's worth automating
  • Connect financial platforms, databases, APIs, and other systems to create more efficient workflows
  • Build every automation with a human review step and audit trail
  • Serve as the team's in-house AI expert and raise everyone's fluency
  • Document every system so a non-technical teammate can run it

  • Can explain technical work clearly to people who don't code
  • Strong spreadsheet skills (Google Suite); finance exposure a plus
  • Diligent documentation and task management; excellent communication
  • Works well independently and on a team
  • Working knowledge of Python, SQL, and REST APIs

Experience
